title: Canonical quotient completion unit criterion without scheme finiteness
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite extension E/Q_ell [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For any scheme T [def-pc-scheme], let B_T be the completed integral coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] and let eta:H -> C_T(H) be the specified strict quotient/Roos completion unit in D(B_T) [def-pur-integral-derived-operations, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Then for every H, eta_H is invertible if and only if H is derived complete [def-weil-derived-complete]. No quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness or invertibility hypothesis on ell in T is required.

source.place: Tag 099M, lemma-naive-completion; algebraization.tex Tag 0A0E, lemma-derived-completion-koszul. The coefficient datum is the existing principal Koszul strict replacement datum.

proof.text: Use the proved principal Koszul strict replacement coefficient_datum to obtain the adic datum whose ideal is spanned by the chosen coefficient uniformizer.

proof.text: Choose a good representative of H by essential surjectivity of qGood. Apply the intrinsic Roos completeness equivalence, whose conditions five and one are respectively invertibility of this specified completion unit and derived completeness. Choose the auxiliary prime 3 if ell=2, and 2 otherwise.

lean.statement:
theorem canonicalCompletionUnitCriterion
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (T : Scheme.{t}) :
    (∀ H : D l E T none,
      IsIso ((completionUnit l E T none).app H) ↔ IsComplete l E T none H)
